title: A C¹ map is injective, with injective derivatives, on a closed ball around a point where its derivative is injective
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (G : Euclid m → Euclid P) (x : Euclid m), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G x) → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Set.InjOn G (Metric.closedBall x r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x r, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G z)
